scope.summary: The per-call RLS/VPD policy observation runs on a separate bounded (1000 ms) observation session instead of the pinned session, so oracle_query on policy-heavy or slow-dictionary schemas returns promptly and concurrent calls no longer get SESSION_BUSY; authorizing policy lookups name SYS.ALL_POLICIES directly.
out_of_scope: Server-side cancellation of a timed-out observation session (it is dropped client-side and lingers on the server for a while) - follow-up bead.
Per-read logon cost and pool max_size bypass of the observation connection - follow-up bead.
Live run of the official oracledb fallback backend's observation session (compiled and clippy-clean only) - follow-up bead.

limitations: The external-client proof script lived outside the repo (/tmp); the in-repo live test live_slow_policy_probe_isolated_from_pinned_session carries the reproducible proof.
The lab slows a private ALL_POLICIES synonym rather than SYS.ALL_POLICIES itself; per-relation authorizing lookups still run on the pinned session under the 30 s budget.
XE21/XE18 E2E_ORACLE baseline test skipped: the CI-public password gives ORA-01017 on those local lab instances.
